text_block_list.text: One morning, while strolling around the academy――

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Grow big and strong, and bloom beautifully, okay?♪

Nishino Flower was tending to some flowers.
Just then...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Nishino Flower!
The teacher was looking for you about classroom duty.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um...
Understood, I'll be right there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yup! Well, I told you, so that's that~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was taking my sweet time watering the flowers,
so I'm only halfway through the flowerbed...!
choice_data_list: Let's split up to make this more efficient!
I'll hurry and fill the watering can!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, when you water them, make sure
to talk to the flowers a whole lot, okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That way, the flowers will be happier
and bloom even more beautifully...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...!
I'll hurry and give them some water too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! I must speak rapidly to the flowers as well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Pwease bwoom big and bootiful――!
Pl-Please bloom beautifully...!
